Select the first 1000 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL3735 (Vascular cell adhesion protein 1) where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation equals exact match, and pchembl_value is not null. Join activities with assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter target chembl_id to CHEMBL3735, target_type to SINGLE PROTEIN, and tax_id to 9606. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
